name: cafard-web
description: cafard's web UIs, the admin UI and the chat app: TypeScript classes, compiled into the static Go binary that serves them.

scripts.build: vite build --mode admin && vite build --mode chat

//engines: The UI is compiled into the binary, so its output is part of the build. The lockfile pins the compilers; this pins the runtime they run on. Node 20 is the floor Vite 6 supports and what dev-build runs.
